fpl.note: Federal poverty guideline for the 48 contiguous states. Update each year.

remedies.name: Contact the Wayne County Treasurer about foreclosure risk
remedies.summary: Property taxes that stay unpaid for multiple years can lead to foreclosure. The sooner you reach out, the more options you usually have.
remedies.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Wayne County Treasurer's office and ask about your exact deadlines and options.
remedies.deadline_note: Deadlines are firm. Ask for your specific dates.

remedies.name: Homeowners Property Tax Assistance Program (HPTAP)
remedies.summary: Help for eligible lower-income homeowners with past-due property taxes.
remedies.how_to_apply: Confirm the current application process and required documents (ID, proof of income, tax bill) with the official program office before applying.
remedies.deadline_note: Funding and application windows can change. Confirm current dates.

remedies.name: Poverty / hardship property tax exemption
remedies.summary: Lower-income homeowners may be able to have some or all of their property tax reduced or exempted.
remedies.how_to_apply: Ask the city assessor's office and the Board of Review how to file, and what income proof they require.
remedies.deadline_note: Filing windows are short and set each year. Confirm the current dates.

remedies.name: Payment plan for past-due taxes
remedies.summary: A payment plan lets you pay what you owe in installments instead of all at once.
remedies.how_to_apply: Contact the Wayne County Treasurer and ask about current payment plan terms and down payment.
remedies.deadline_note: Missing payments can cancel a plan. Ask what happens if you fall behind.

remedies.name: Appeal your assessed value (Board of Review)
remedies.summary: If your home's assessed value seems too high, you can ask the Board of Review to lower it, which can lower future tax bills.
remedies.how_to_apply: Gather comparable sales and photos of the home's condition, then ask the city assessor's office how to file an appeal.
remedies.deadline_note: Appeal windows are short and fixed each year. Check the current dates right away.

remedies.name: Principal Residence Exemption (PRE)
remedies.summary: Owner-occupied homes may qualify for an exemption from certain school operating taxes. Make sure yours is on file.
remedies.how_to_apply: Ask the city assessor's office to confirm whether an exemption is on file for your home and how to file if not.
remedies.deadline_note: Filing deadlines apply. Confirm the current ones.
